ideas.pitch: An interactive exploratory dashboard and machine learning ranking system designed to evaluate and surface the top 10 youngest uncapped domestic cricket players.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Find the Youngest Uncapped Stars Analyse the data pack of uncapped domestic players, along with public data, and submit your top 10 picks and rationale as a PDF, PPT or dashboard.
ideas.title: RoyalsScout: Uncapped Domestic Talent Matrix
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly answers Round 1 requirements by combining the exclusive RR dataset with advanced predictive aging models, mimicking the exact workflow that successfully surfaced Vignesh Puthur in Season 1.
